voice: First person singular, plain and direct, builder-in-public. Short: 450-700 words, never more. A few H2 sections, short paragraphs, one clear takeaway. Honest about what failed. Fluid, natural prose: full sentences joined with ordinary commas and conjunctions. Go easy on colons, dashes, semicolons, parentheses and quotation marks; no bold, no blockquotes, and bullet lists only when the content is truly a list. No emojis, no hashtags, no 'In today's fast-paced world'.
private: No names of private people (friends, family, beta users, clients). Public figures and authors of cited work are fine.
No secrets, tokens, passwords, emails, phone numbers, home-folder paths or internal URLs (dashboards, admin pages, preview links).
